   1 │ # model_router.py — Intent detection, domain detection, request routing
   2 │ # Extracted from agent.py — single source of truth for all routing logic
   3 │ 
   4 │ import llm_client
   5 │ from llm_client  import safe_chat, get_response

   7 │ 
   8 │ 
   9 │ # ── Domain Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  10 │ # Imported lazily via lambdas to avoid circular imports at module load time.
  11 │ # To add a new domain: add ONE entry here — routing is automatic everywhere.
  12 │ def _build_domain_registry() -> dict:
  13 │     from dotnet_templates  import (DOTNET_PLANNING_PROMPT, DOTNET_FULLSTACK_PLANNING_PROMPT,
  14 │                                    get_dotnet_ext as _get_dotnet_ext)
  15 │     from react_templates   import REACT_PLANNING_PROMPT,   get_react_ext
  16 │     from angular_templates import ANGULAR_PLANNING_PROMPT, get_angular_ext
  17 │     from html_templates    import HTML_PLANNING_PROMPT,    get_html_ext
  18 │     from sql_templates     import SQL_PLANNING_PROMPT
  19 │     from python_templates  import PYTHON_PLANNING_PROMPT
  20 │ 
  21 │     return {
  22 │         "unity": {
  23 │             "keywords": ["unity", "يونتي"],
  24 │             "planning": None,
  25 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: ".cs",
  26 │             "lang": "Unity C#",
  27 │             "launchable": False,
  28 │             "validator": "unity",
  29 │         },
  30 │         "unreal": {
  31 │             "keywords": ["unreal", "c++", "أنريل"],
  32 │             "planning": None,
  33 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: ".h",
  34 │             "lang": "Unreal C++",
  35 │             "launchable": False,
  36 │             "validator": "unreal",
  37 │         },
  38 │         "dotnet": {
  39 │             "keywords": ["dotnet", ".net", "asp.net", "aspnet", "web api", "webapi"],
  40 │             "planning": lambda task: (
  41 │                 DOTNET_FULLSTACK_PLANNING_PROMPT
  42 │                 if any(w in task.lower() for w in ["website", "web app", "mvc", "razor", "موقع", "frontend"])
  43 │                 else DOTNET_PLANNING_PROMPT
  44 │             ).format(task=task),
  45 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: _get_dotnet_ext(n, r),
  46 │             "lang": "ASP.NET Core C#",
  47 │             "launchable": True,
  48 │         },
  49 │         "react": {
  50 │             "keywords": ["react", "reactjs", "react.js", "vite", "nextjs", "next.js"],
  51 │             "planning": lambda t: REACT_PLANNING_PROMPT.format(task=t),
  52 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: get_react_ext(n, r),
  53 │             "lang": "React.js",
  54 │             "launchable": True,
  55 │         },
  56 │         "angular": {
  57 │             "keywords": ["angular", "angularjs", "ng "],
  58 │             "planning": lambda t: ANGULAR_PLANNING_PROMPT.format(task=t),
  59 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: get_angular_ext(n, r),
  60 │             "lang": "Angular TypeScript",
  61 │             "launchable": True,
  62 │         },
  63 │         "html": {
  64 │             "keywords": ["html", "html5", "vanilla js", "static site", "plain website"],
  65 │             "planning": lambda t: HTML_PLANNING_PROMPT.format(task=t),
  66 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: get_html_ext(n, r),
  67 │             "lang": "HTML/CSS/JS",
  68 │             "launchable": True,
  69 │         },
  70 │         "sql": {
  71 │             "keywords": ["sql", "database", "postgres", "postgresql", "mysql",
  72 │                          "sqlite", "db schema", "قاعدة بيانات"],
  73 │             "planning": lambda t: SQL_PLANNING_PROMPT.format(task=t),
  74 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: ".sql",
  75 │             "lang": "SQL",
  76 │             "launchable": False,
  77 │         },
  78 │         "python": {
  79 │             "keywords": ["python", "بايثون", "fastapi", "flask", "script", "pip"],
  80 │             "planning": lambda t: PYTHON_PLANNING_PROMPT.format(task=t),
  81 │             "get_ext": lambda n, r: ".py",
  82 │             "lang": "Python",
  83 │             "launchable": False,
  84 │         },
  85 │     }
  86 │ 
  87 │ 
  88 │ # Build once at import time
  89 │ DOMAIN_REGISTRY = _build_domain_registry()
  90 │ 
  91 │ 
  92 │ # ── Domain detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  93 │ def detect_domain(task: str) -> str:
  94 │     """Detect domain from task text. Returns domain key or 'general'."""
  95 │     t = task.lower()
  96 │     for domain in ["unity", "unreal", "dotnet", "react", "angular", "html", "sql", "python"]:
  97 │         if any(kw in t for kw in DOMAIN_REGISTRY[domain]["keywords"]):
  98 │             return domain
  99 │     return "general"
 100 │ 
 101 │ 
 102 │ # Alias kept for backward compatibility
 103 │ detect_requested_language = detect_domain
 104 │ 
 105 │ 
 106 │ # ── Intent / mode detection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
 107 │ def detect_mode(user: str) -> tuple:
 108 │     """
 109 │     Smart intent router — rule-based fast path, LLM fallback for ambiguous cases.
 110 │ 
 111 │     Priority:
 112 │       1. Hard system commands  (never LLM)
 113 │       2. Fast keyword rules    (saves LLM call for obvious cases)
 114 │       3. LLM classification    (skipped for short messages < 4 words)
 115 │ 
 116 │     Returns: (mode: str, domain: str)
 117 │     """
 118 │     t = user.lower().strip()
 119 │ 
 120 │     # ── 1. Hard system commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 121 │     if t.startswith("attach "):       return "ATTACH",       "general"
 122 │     if t == "clear":                  return "CLEAR",        "general"
 123 │     if t == "run":                    return "RUN",          "general"
 124 │     if t.startswith("/auto ") or t.startswith("/autonomous "):
 125 │         return "AUTO", "general"
 126 │     
 127 │     if t.startswith("/multi ") or t.startswith("/multiagent "):
 128 │         return "MULTI", "general"
 129 │ 
 130 │     if t.startswith("load_session "): 
 131 │         return "LOAD_SESSION", "general"
 132 │ 
 133 │     # ── 2. Keyword sets ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 134 │     CREATION_VERBS = [
 135 │         "make", "create", "build", "generate", "write", "design",
 136 │         "عمل", "اعمل", "عايز", "ابني", "انشئ", "اكتب", "سوّي",
 137 │     ]
 138 │     GAME_TARGETS = [
 139 │         "game", "لعبة", "unity", "unreal",
 140 │         "shooter", "platformer", "racing", "puzzle", "rpg",
 141 │         "tower defense", "moba", "battle royale", "roguelike", "roguelite",
 142 │         "fighting", "stealth", "horror", "idle", "fishing", "cooking",
 143 │         "flight", "kart", "runner", "brawler", "strategy", "simulation",
 144 │         "sandbox", "survival", "dungeon", "metroidvania", "vr game", "ar game",
 145 │     ]
 146 │     JOB_KEYWORDS = [
 147 │         "job", "jobs", "hiring", "وظيفة", "وظائف", "شغل", "فرص",
 148 │         "career", "vacancy", "vacancies", "توظيف",
 149 │     ]
 150 │     DELETE_KEYWORDS = ["delete", "remove", "احذف", "امسح", "شيل"]
 151 │     LANG_KEYWORDS   = [
 152 │         "python", "بايثون", "unity", "unreal", "c#", "c++", "csharp", "dotnet", ".net",
 153 │         "asp.net", "aspnet", "fastapi", "flask", "django", "react", "angular",
 154 │         "html", "sql", "postgres", "server", "api",
 155 │     ]
 156 │     # NEW: explicit run/execute words — RUN intent is only trusted when one is present
 157 │     RUN_KEYWORDS = [
 158 │         "run ", "execute", "launch", "operate", "start the",
 159 │         "شغّل", "شغل المشروع", "نفذ", "نفّذ", "تشغيل",
 160 │     ]
 161 │     # NEW: small code-snippet indicators — a snippet is conversational (CHAT),
 162 │     # not a full project (GAME) and not a run command (RUN)
 163 │     SNIPPET_WORDS = [
 164 │         "function", "func ", "method", "snippet", "algorithm", "regex",
 165 │         "one-liner", "دالة", "فانكشن", "ميثود", "خوارزمية", "مثال كود",
 166 │         "كود صغير", "سكربت صغير",
 167 │     ]
 168 │     SELF_MOD_KEYWORDS = [
 169 │         # Direct modification commands
 170 │         "add feature", "improve yourself", "update yourself", "modify yourself",
 171 │         "add support for", "teach yourself", "expand yourself",
 172 │         "edit yourself", "change yourself", "fix yourself",
 173 │         "add to yourself", "upgrade yourself", "update your code",
 174 │         # "add a X" patterns — adding something to the agent
 175 │         "add a command", "add a tool", "add new feature", "add a feature",
 176 │         "add a /", "add support", "add the ability", "add an option",
 177 │         "add a status", "add a mode", "add a function", "add a feature",
 178 │         "add a new", "add new",
 179 │         # Capability questions
 180 │         "can you edit yourself", "can you modify yourself",
 181 │         "can you improve yourself", "can you update yourself",
 182 │         "can you change yourself",
 183 │         # Arabic
 184 │         "طور نفسك", "اضف ميزة", "حدث نفسك", "عدل نفسك",
 185 │         "تقدر تعدل نفسك", "تقدر تحسن نفسك", "عايزك تضيف",
 186 │     ]
 187 │     QUESTION_STARTS = [
 188 │         "what", "how", "why", "when", "who", "which", "explain", "tell me",
 189 │         "describe", "show me", "is ", "are ", "ما", "كيف", "ليه", "متى", "من",
 190 │         "اشرح", "وضّح", "قولي", "أفضل", "افضل", "ما هي", "ماهي", "ما هو",
 191 │         "ما الفرق", "what is", "what are", "which is", "compare", "difference",
 192 │     ]
 193 │     OPINION_WORDS = [
 194 │         " is ", " are ", " was ", " seems ", " looks ", " feels ",
 195 │         " بيعمل ", " بيحصل ", " غريب", " صعب", " سهل",
 196 │     ]
 197 │ 
 198 │     has_verb    = any(kw in t for kw in CREATION_VERBS)
 199 │     has_target  = any(kw in t for kw in GAME_TARGETS)
 200 │     has_lang    = any(kw in t for kw in LANG_KEYWORDS)
 201 │     has_job     = any(kw in t for kw in JOB_KEYWORDS)
 202 │     has_del     = any(kw in t for kw in DELETE_KEYWORDS)
 203 │     has_run     = any(kw in t for kw in RUN_KEYWORDS)      # NEW
 204 │     has_snippet = any(kw in t for kw in SNIPPET_WORDS)     # NEW
 205 │ 
 206 │     is_question = (
 207 │         any(t.startswith(q + " ") or t.startswith(q) or t == q for q in QUESTION_STARTS)
 208 │         or t.endswith("?") or t.endswith("؟")
 209 │     )
 210 │     is_opinion  = any(op in t for op in OPINION_WORDS)
 211 │ 
 212 │     if has_del:
 213 │         return "DELETE", "general"
 214 │ 
 215 │     if has_job and not is_question:
 216 │         return "JOB", "general"
 217 │ 
 218 │     # Vague/exploratory phrasing → chat first, don't auto-generate
 219 │     _VAGUE = [
